answer: Give each new identity a low rewards cap that increases only after unrelated peers verify random samples of its work against signed source records. Cluster accounts that share endorsers or recycle evidence and limit the whole cluster to one participant. Auditors might compare a canyon survey to raw coordinates, a voyage log to timestamped sensor data, or dune measurements to original images. To scale a Sybil swarm, an attacker must maintain distinct, checkable records and persuade separate reviewers, not just create keys.
